sections.title: Listening Part 2: Victoria Arts Center Facilities

sections.instructions: Listen to the guide and complete Questions 1-6. For Questions 1-3, complete the sentences with NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. For Questions 4-6, choose the correct letter A-D.
sections.instructionsVi: Nghe người hướng dẫn và trả lời câu 1-6.
sections.audioText: Good afternoon everyone and welcome to the Victoria Arts Center. Before our private guided tour commences, allow me to brief you on our primary amenities. The main foyer has been recently refurbished with an interactive digital kiosk where you can reserve performance tickets or review schedule updates. If you require audio headsets for simultaneous interpretation, those can be checked out from the information counter just beside the central fountain. As you proceed down the North Gallery, you will notice the contemporary sculpture exhibition on your left. Directly opposite that, on your right, is the archival reading room which houses manuscripts dating back to the eighteenth century. For refreshments, the rooftop terrace café provides panoramic views of the harbor and operates until 10:30 PM. Please be advised that flash photography is prohibited in all galleries to prevent pigment degradation of fragile canvases. Enjoy your afternoon!

sections.title: Reading: Neural Mechanisms of Long-Term Memory Storage
sections.titleVi: Đọc hiểu: Cơ chế nơ-ron lưu trữ ký ức dài hạn
sections.instructions: Read the text and answer Questions 1-5.
sections.instructionsVi: Đọc văn bản và trả lời câu hỏi 1-5.
sections.passageTitle: Synaptic Plasticity and Sleep-Dependent Memory Consolidation
sections.passageTitleVi: Tính Dẻo Khớp Thần Kinh và Quá Trình Củng Cố Ký Ức Trong Giấc Ngủ
sections.passageText:
Paragraph 1: For over a century, neuroscientists debated how fleeting experiential impressions are converted into permanent biological traces. The prevailing two-stage model posits that new declarative information is initially encoded within the fragile circuitry of the hippocampus. Over subsequent hours, and particularly during slow-wave non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, coordinated electrophysiological oscillations—specifically cortical slow oscillations, thalamocortical sleep spindles, and hippocampal sharp-wave ripples—orchestrate the systematic transfer of representations from the temporary hippocampal repository into the neocortex for indefinite consolidation.

Paragraph 2: Disruption of this nocturnal tri-coupling rhythm precipitates marked cognitive deficits. Experimental paradigms utilizing targeted memory reactivation (TMR) demonstrate that delivering subtle acoustic sensory cues during slow-wave sleep can selectively enhance memory recall the following morning. Conversely, chronic sleep deprivation degrades synaptic density and impedes the brain's glymphatic clearance mechanism, allowing metabolic waste products such as beta-amyloid proteins to accumulate, thereby elevating long-term vulnerability to neurodegenerative pathologies.

questions.prompt: Declarative memories are permanently housed within the hippocampus throughout a person's lifespan.
questions.promptVi: Ký ức tường thuật được lưu trữ vĩnh viễn bên trong hồi hải mã (hippocampus) suốt cả cuộc đời con người.
questions.explanation: Paragraph 1 states that the hippocampus is a 'temporary hippocampal repository' and memories are transferred into the 'neocortex for indefinite consolidation'. Thus, they are NOT permanently housed in the hippocampus.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ hồi hải mã chỉ là nơi lưu trữ tạm thời ('temporary hippocampal repository'), ký ức sau đó được chuyển sang vỏ não ('neocortex') để củng cố vĩnh viễn. Nhận định mâu thuẫn với quan điểm bài viết -> NO.
questions.evidenceText: transfer of representations from the temporary hippocampal repository into the neocortex for indefinite consolidation.

questions.prompt: Long-term memory transfer occurs predominantly during _____ sleep.
questions.promptVi: Quá trình chuyển ký ức dài hạn diễn ra chủ yếu trong giấc ngủ _____.
questions.explanation: Paragraph 1 states: 'particularly during slow-wave non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep... orchestrate the systematic transfer'.
questions.explanationVi: Dẫn chứng: 'particularly during slow-wave non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep...'
questions.evidenceText: particularly during slow-wave non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, coordinated electrophysiological oscillations... orchestrate the systematic transfer

questions.promptVi: Kỹ thuật thực nghiệm nào truyền tín hiệu cảm giác trong giấc ngủ để tăng cường khả năng nhớ lại?
questions.explanation: Paragraph 2 identifies: 'Experimental paradigms utilizing targeted memory reactivation (TMR) demonstrate that delivering subtle acoustic sensory cues...'
questions.evidenceText: Experimental paradigms utilizing targeted memory reactivation (TMR) demonstrate that delivering subtle acoustic sensory cues during slow-wave sleep can selectively enhance memory recall

questions.prompt: According to Paragraph 2, chronic sleep deprivation impedes what physiological process?
questions.promptVi: Theo Đoạn 2, thiếu ngủ mãn tính làm cản trở quá trình sinh lý nào?

options.text: The glymphatic clearance mechanism of metabolic waste
options.textVi: Cơ chế dọn dẹp chất thải chuyển hóa của hệ glymphatic

questions.explanation: Paragraph 2 states: 'impedes the brain's glymphatic clearance mechanism, allowing metabolic waste products such as beta-amyloid proteins to accumulate'.
questions.explanationVi: Dẫn chứng trực tiếp: 'impedes the brain's glymphatic clearance mechanism...'
questions.evidenceText: impedes the brain's glymphatic clearance mechanism, allowing metabolic waste products such as beta-amyloid proteins to accumulate

sections.title: Writing Task 1 Academic: Bar Chart Report
sections.titleVi: Viết Task 1: Báo cáo số liệu biểu đồ cột
sections.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. The chart below shows the percentage of electricity generated from renewable sources in four countries between 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
sections.instructionsVi: Dành 20 phút. Tóm tắt thông tin bằng cách chọn lọc và báo cáo các đặc điểm chính, thực hiện so sánh đối chiếu. Viết tối thiểu 150 từ.

questions.prompt: The bar chart illustrates the proportion of national electricity produced from renewable energy sources (hydro, wind, solar) across Germany, Norway, Japan, and Australia in three years: 2010, 2015, and 2020. Summarise the main trends and make comparisons where relevant.
questions.promptVi: Biểu đồ cột minh họa tỷ lệ sản xuất điện từ năng lượng tái tạo tại 4 quốc gia trong các năm 2010, 2015 và 2020.
questions.explanation: A high-scoring Task 1 response requires: (1) Paraphrased introduction, (2) Clear 2-sentence Overview identifying Norway's undisputed dominance (near 98%) and Germany's dramatic upward trajectory (quadrupling), (3) Body 1 detailing Norway and Germany, (4) Body 2 detailing Japan and Australia with specific percentage figures.
questions.explanationVi: Bài viết Task 1 chuẩn Band 8.0: Cần có Introduction diễn đạt lại câu hỏi, Overview nêu bật Na Uy áp đảo và Đức tăng trưởng mạnh nhất, Thân bài 1 so sánh Na Uy và Đức, Thân bài 2 phân tích Nhật Bản và Úc kèm số liệu chính xác.
